title: Computing with traceable tensor networks
summary: We introduce a new SVD-based tensor decomposition method for tensor networks with arbitrary graph topologies, extending classical hierarchical SVD-based techniques to networks with cycles and general connectivity. We also introduce addition and rounding procedures for traceable tensor graphs, enabling step-rounding time integration of high-dimensional PDEs directly in graph format, with rank truncation controlled to a prescribed tolerance at every time step.
